g.text: M6 one successful run (manual or admitted by auto session)
run with admitted RunId and owned token
Start(handle, samples, count, callback, rooted context)
unregister token / release callback context and extra handle reference
cancellation accepted before this point prevents saving
close stop admission / finish callbacks and timer cleanup
Late cancellation or timeout cannot replace storage outcome.
Save failure throws InspectionRunException with the computed result.
